recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. Future changes to device-endpoint or device-gateway should be made in HL7/fhir-extensions unless a later Jira requires a specific core narrative update.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive FMG issue asking to create one or more extensions on Device for communication-related elements moved out of Device as part of the FHIR-32565 Device cleanup.
initial_application: Core commit 2286646d6c79a907f5e539b73445661331094313 commented Device.endpoint and Device.gateway out of the active Device StructureDefinition source. The concrete extension creation was applied in HL7/fhir-extensions commit 18273876b410b74a1f4f65f8002bdeae707ad052 / PR #166, as recorded on FHIR-48923 and FHIR-47326.
additional_context: FHIR-47326 is the same change family in the Extension Pack and specifies device-endpoint and device-gateway; it also clarifies that Device.url was not removed and therefore did not get a new extension. FHIR-32565 is the broader Applied core decision to move selected Device elements into extensions. FMG minutes approved FHIR-48923 6-0-1 for moving Device communication elements into the extensions pack.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. Device is active in source/fhir.ini, the current core Device XML has endpoint/gateway commented out of the active element list, the Device introduction names device-gateway and device-endpoint as replacement extensions, and the Extension Pack checkout contains the active extension StructureDefinitions.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-extensions issue that specified and applied device-endpoint and device-gateway in PR #166 / commit 1827387.
Broader core Device decision to move endpoint and gateway, along with other Device elements, out of the resource and into extensions.
